about: Facts on the site that can't come from the data (phone numbers, laws). Each is checked weekly by pipeline/check_outside.js: the site must still say it (says), and its official source page must still say it too (expect, matched case-insensitively against the page's text). A failed check opens a GitHub issue; it doesn't stop the weekly data update. Every outside link on the site is also checked to still open.

formPages.about: The City's request forms open as .../cwi/direct/<CODE>, and the form site shows the same page for any code, real or not. So each code the site uses (CWI + 'CODE' in site/app.js) must still be linked from one of these official City pages.
